messages.text:
I found the wooden watch box in order h02-o1. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

I can't refund 69 reais. The records show you paid 49.00 BRL for that unit, and a refund is what was paid for the unit. Nobody can raise that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount).

I can request a refund of 49.00 BRL, paid to your original payment. A staff member must approve it after you confirm. Would you like me to create that proposal?

messages.text: Why is the refund only 49 reais?

The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). The shop's records show 49.00 BRL paid for the wooden watch box in order h02-o1. That is the most the policy allows, and it can't be raised. Shipping charges aren't part of the amount either (refund-policy/v2/amount).

If you'd like the 49.00 BRL refund, tell me and I'll create the proposal. You then confirm it with the button on the proposal card.
